newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS crude prices ease on report of build - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS crude prices ease on report of build - Feb 11.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS crude prices fell in overnight trade Tuesday, pressured lower by a build in U.S. inventories, brokers said.
The American Petroleum Institute, an oil trade group based in Washington D.C., reported a 3.6 million barrel increase that put total U.S. stocks at 29.9 million.
In overnight trade, March crude oil 13 cents a barrel to $22.29 a barrel, as 675 lots changed hands for the nearby contract.
"We're at key long-term support levels," a trader said, adding prices would remain choppy this week if sales stayed above those levels.

Front-month gasoline futures fell 0.36 cents a gallon to 63.60 cents, with 134 lots traded. Traders said last week's build of 3.3 million barrels was larger-than-expected and implied demand was weaker than forecast.
Traders waited for next week's API report to judge the direction of heating oil, which eased overnight by 0.06 cents a gallon to 61.80 cents.
About 211 lots changed hands, traders said.
